# vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk (Data Source)

Read all tenant metric label values as a dictionary of label keys to values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_tenant" "example" {
  name = "default"
}

data "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "example" {
  tenant_id = data.vastdata_tenant.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant whose metric label values are read.

### Read-Only

- `values` (Map of String) Dictionary of metric label keys to values.
